from google.oauth2 import service_account
from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
from google.cloud import identity

# Configuration
PROJECT_ID = 'your-project-id'
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH = 'path/to/service-account-key.json'

# Initialize client
credentials = service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_file(
    SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH,
    scopes=['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-identity.readonly']
)
client = identity.IdentityServiceClient(credentials=credentials)

# Function to register a new user
def register_user(email, password):
    user = identity.User()
    user.primary_email = email
    user.name = identity.UserName(given_name='User', family_name='Test')
    user.password = password
    parent = f'projects/{PROJECT_ID}'
    response = client.create_user(parent=parent, user=user)
    return response

from google.cloud import language
from google.cloud.language import enums

# Configuration
PROJECT_ID = 'your-project-id'

# Initialize client
client = language.LanguageServiceClient()

# Function to moderate profile text
def moderate_profile_text(text):
    document = language.Document(content=text, type_=enums.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    response = client.analyze_sentiment(document)
    sentiment = response.document_sentiment
    if sentiment.score < -0.2:
        return 'Moderation required'
    return 'Moderation not required'

# Configuration

LOCATION = 'us'

# Function to summarize onboarding state
def summarize_onboarding_state(text):
    name = f'projects/{PROJECT_ID}/locations/{LOCATION}/processors/{PROCESSOR_ID}'
    document = documentai.Document(content=text.encode('utf-8'), mime_type='text/plain')
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, document=document)
    response = client.process_document(request=request)
    return response.document_text_annotation

        'timestamp': firestore.SERVER_TIMESTAMP,
